# discord_scheduled_event (Resource)

Manages a server scheduled event in a stage channel, a voice channel or an external location. Events are visible to server members only.

Discord moves events through their `status` on its own: external events start and end at their scheduled times, stage and voice events end a few minutes after everyone leaves the channel, and events that never start are canceled a few hours after their start time. Starting and ending events is left to Discord and the people hosting them. A completed or canceled event cannot be changed, so it is removed from state; the next plan creates a new event, which needs a `scheduled_start_time` in the future.

The bot needs the Create Events permission, and Manage Events to change or delete events created by others. Stage events also need Manage Channels, Mute Members and Move Members on the channel, and voice events View Channel and Connect. A server can have at most 100 scheduled or active events.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A weekly community call in a stage channel.
resource "discord_scheduled_event" "community_call" {
  server_id            = var.server_id
  name                 = "Community call"
  description          = "Roadmap updates and open questions."
  entity_type          = "stage_instance"
  channel_id           = discord_stage_channel.town_hall.id
  scheduled_start_time = "2030-01-08T18:00:00Z"

  recurrence_rule = {
    frequency  = "weekly"
    by_weekday = ["tuesday"]
  }
}

# A meetup outside Discord. With Terraform 1.11 or later, image_wo keeps the
# cover image out of state; bump image_wo_version to upload a new one.
resource "discord_scheduled_event" "meetup" {
  server_id            = var.server_id
  name                 = "Meetup"
  entity_type          = "external"
  location             = "https://example.com/meetup"
  scheduled_start_time = "2030-03-01T17:00:00Z"
  scheduled_end_time   = "2030-03-01T20:00:00Z"
  image_wo             = "data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("${path.module}/cover.png")}"
  image_wo_version     = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entity_type` (String) Where the event takes place: `stage_instance`, `voice`, `external`. `stage_instance` and `voice` events need `channel_id`; `external` events need `location` and `scheduled_end_time`.
- `name` (String) Event name (1-100 characters).
- `scheduled_start_time` (String) When the event starts, as an RFC 3339 timestamp such as `2030-01-01T18:00:00Z`. Discord requires it to be in the future when the event is created. Write it in UTC (`Z`) so that an imported event plans no change.
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `audit_log_reason` (String) Reason recorded in the server's audit log for creating and changing the event (Discord records no reason for deleting it), overriding the provider's `audit_log_reason`. Up to 512 characters. Changing only this argument updates state without calling Discord.
- `channel_id` (String) ID of the stage channel (`stage_instance`) or voice channel (`voice`) the event is hosted in. Must not be set for `external` events.
- `description` (String) Event description (1-1000 characters).
- `image` (String) Cover image as a data URI (PNG, JPEG or WebP), e.g. `"data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("cover.png")}"`. Stored in state; prefer `image_wo` on Terraform 1.11 or later. Removing it removes the cover image.
- `image_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Cover image as a data URI (PNG, JPEG or WebP). Write-only: the value is never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later and `image_wo_version`. Conflicts with `image`.
- `image_wo_version` (Number) Version of `image_wo`. Setting or changing it uploads `image_wo`; removing it removes the cover image unless `image` is set.
- `location` (String) Location of an `external` event (1-100 characters), such as a URL or an address.
- `recurrence_rule` (Attributes) Makes the event repeat, starting at `scheduled_start_time`. Discord supports a subset of iCalendar rules: `by_weekday` only with `daily` or `weekly`, `by_n_weekday` only with `monthly`, and `by_month` with `by_month_day` only with `yearly`. Recurrences cannot end on a date or after a count. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recurrence_rule))
- `scheduled_end_time` (String) When the event ends, as an RFC 3339 timestamp after `scheduled_start_time`. Required for `external` events.

### Read-Only

- `creator_id` (String) ID of the user that created the event.
- `id` (String) Scheduled event ID.
- `image_hash` (String) Hash of the current cover image. A change made outside Terraform makes the next plan upload the configured image again.
- `status` (String) Current status: `scheduled` or `active`. Completed and canceled events are removed from state.

<a id="nestedatt--recurrence_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recurrence_rule`

Required:

- `frequency` (String) How often the event repeats: `yearly`, `monthly`, `weekly`, `daily`.

Optional:

- `by_month` (Set of String) Month a `yearly` event occurs in: `january`, `february`, `march`, `april`, `may`, `june`, `july`, `august`, `september`, `october`, `november`, `december`. Exactly one month; requires `by_month_day`.
- `by_month_day` (Set of Number) Day of the month a `yearly` event occurs on, `1` to `31`. Exactly one day; requires `by_month`.
- `by_n_weekday` (Attributes List) The day of a given week of the month a `monthly` event occurs on. Exactly one entry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recurrence_rule--by_n_weekday))
- `by_weekday` (Set of String) Days of the week the event occurs on: `monday`, `tuesday`, `wednesday`, `thursday`, `friday`, `saturday`, `sunday`. `weekly` events take one day; `daily` events take one of these sets: Monday-Friday, Tuesday-Saturday, Sunday-Thursday, Friday-Saturday, Saturday-Sunday or Sunday-Monday.
- `interval` (Number) Number of `frequency` periods between occurrences. Only `weekly` events accept `2`, for every other week. Defaults to `1`.

<a id="nestedatt--recurrence_rule--by_n_weekday"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recurrence_rule.by_n_weekday`

Required:

- `day` (String) Day of the week: `monday`, `tuesday`, `wednesday`, `thursday`, `friday`, `saturday`, `sunday`.
- `n` (Number) Week of the month, `1` to `5`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = discord_scheduled_event.meetup
  identity = {
    server_id = "234567890123456789"
    event_id  = "567890123456789012"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `event_id` (String) ID of the scheduled event.
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import discord_scheduled_event.meetup <server_id>/<event_id>
```
